properties.script:
import json
import re
import sys

organizationName, deploymentName, descriptionValue, definitionNameInput, prefixInput, scheduleSelector, clearScheduleText, rolloutInput = sys.argv[1:9]
namePattern = r"^(?:[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9\- _]{0,31})$"
prefixPattern = r"^(?:[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9\-_]{0,31})$"
ruleErrors0 = json.dumps(["Workload Organization must not be blank."] if organizationName == "" else [], separators=(",", ":"))
ruleErrors1 = json.dumps(["Workload Deployment Name is invalid."] if not re.search(namePattern, deploymentName) else [], separators=(",", ":"))
ruleErrors2 = json.dumps(["Description must be at most 1024 characters and start alphanumerically when nonempty."] if re.search(r"(?s)^.{1025,}$", descriptionValue) or (descriptionValue != "" and not re.search(r"^[a-zA-Z0-9]", descriptionValue)) else [], separators=(",", ":"))
ruleErrors3 = json.dumps(["Workload Definition Name is invalid."] if definitionNameInput != "" and not re.search(namePattern, definitionNameInput) else [], separators=(",", ":"))
ruleErrors4 = json.dumps(["Workload Instance Prefix is invalid."] if prefixInput != "" and not re.search(prefixPattern, prefixInput) else [], separators=(",", ":"))
ruleErrors5 = json.dumps(["Schedule Policy selector and Clear Schedule Policy cannot both be set."] if scheduleSelector != "" and clearScheduleText == "true" else [], separators=(",", ":"))
ruleErrors6 = json.dumps(["Rollout Strategy must be blank, Batch, or Canary."] if rolloutInput != "" and rolloutInput not in ("Batch", "Canary") else [], separators=(",", ":"))

properties.script:
import json
import re
import sys
status = 'invalid'
failureCode = '400'
failureMessage = 'Input validation failed'
failureError = 'One or more update inputs are invalid.'
failureResult = '{}'
organizationName = sys.argv[17]
deploymentName = sys.argv[18]
descriptionValue = sys.argv[3]
definitionNameInput = sys.argv[19]
usePreferredInput = sys.argv[32] == 'true'
versionText = sys.argv[33]
poolSelector = sys.argv[20]
prefixInput = sys.argv[21]
startText = sys.argv[34]
digitText = sys.argv[35]
blueprintsText = sys.argv[22]
qualifiersText = sys.argv[23]
scheduleSelector = sys.argv[24]
clearSchedule = sys.argv[36] == 'true'
rolloutInput = sys.argv[25]
tagsText = sys.argv[26]
namePattern = re.compile('^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9\\- _]{0,31}$')
prefixPattern = re.compile('^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9\\-_]{0,31}$')
errors = []
errors.extend(json.loads(sys.argv[37]))
errors.extend(json.loads(sys.argv[38]))
errors.extend(json.loads(sys.argv[39]))
errors.extend(json.loads(sys.argv[40]))
try:
    versionInput = int(versionText)
except Exception:
    versionInput = 0
if definitionNameInput and (not usePreferredInput) and (versionInput < 1):
    errors.append('Workload Definition Version must be at least 1 for a non-preferred replacement.')
errors.extend(json.loads(sys.argv[41]))
try:
    startIndexInput = int(startText)
except Exception:
    startIndexInput = 0
if startIndexInput < 0:
    errors.append('Start Index for Suffix must be 0 for no change or at least 1.')
try:
    digitCountInput = int(digitText)
except Exception:
    digitCountInput = 0
if digitCountInput not in {0, 1, 2, 3, 4}:
    errors.append('Digit Count must be 0 for no change or 1 through 4.')
errors.extend(json.loads(sys.argv[42]))
errors.extend(json.loads(sys.argv[43]))

def parse_optional_array(text, label):
    if not text:
        return ('false', [])
    value = json.loads(text)
    if not isinstance(value, list):
        raise ValueError(label + ' must be a JSON array.')
    return ('true', value)
try:
    blueprintsSupplied, blueprints = parse_optional_array(blueprintsText, 'Blueprint Input Overrides')
    qualifiersSupplied, qualifiers = parse_optional_array(qualifiersText, 'Resource Qualifiers')
    tagsSupplied, tags = parse_optional_array(tagsText, 'Tags')
    for tag in tags:
        if not isinstance(tag, dict) or not set(tag).issubset({'Key', 'Value'}) or (not isinstance(tag.get('Key'), str)) or (not 1 <= len(tag['Key']) <= 356) or (not isinstance(tag.get('Value', ''), str)) or (len(tag.get('Value', '')) > 256):
            raise ValueError('Every tag must contain only a valid Key and optional Value.')
except Exception as exc:
    blueprintsSupplied = qualifiersSupplied = tagsSupplied = 'false'
    blueprints = qualifiers = tags = []
    errors.append('JSON input validation failed: ' + str(exc))
escapedOrganizationName = sys.argv[27]
escapedDeploymentName = sys.argv[28]
escapedPoolSelector = sys.argv[29]
escapedPrefixInput = sys.argv[30]
escapedScheduleSelector = sys.argv[31]
blueprintsJson = json.dumps(blueprints, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False)
qualifiersJson = json.dumps(qualifiers, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False)
tagsJson = json.dumps(tags, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False)
usePreferredInputText = 'true' if usePreferredInput else 'false'
clearScheduleText = 'true' if clearSchedule else 'false'
definitionChange = 'true' if definitionNameInput else 'false'
poolChange = 'true' if poolSelector else 'false'
prefixChange = 'true' if prefixInput else 'false'
scheduleChange = 'true' if scheduleSelector or clearSchedule else 'false'
if errors:
    failureError = ' '.join(errors)
    failureResult = json.dumps({'error': failureMessage, 'details': failureError}, separators=(',', ':'))
else:
    status = 'ready'
    failureCode = failureMessage = failureError = ''
    failureResult = '{}'
